MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 10

2. Solve for x: x + 5 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 6

3. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 65

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

8. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 36

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. They are equal

10. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 18

15. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

18. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

20. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 46
   B. 23
   C. 30
   D. 120

22. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

23. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

24. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37
